explanation: Matches the 'in particular' question 'is F(N) > N^{1/2-o(1)}?' with the negative answer. It negates the existence of f → 0 with F(N) > N^{1/2-f(N)} eventually. NonDividing (no a divides the sum of a nonempty subset of A ∖ {a}) matches the page's definition. A proof from the Pham–Zakharov variant is included.
